turns.content: Describe the Earth-to-Mars Hohmann transfer ellipse and explain why the one-way flight time is half of its orbital period.
Take the transfer semimajor axis to be the geometric mean sqrt(r_E r_M).
Using G=6.67e-11 SI and M_sun=1.99e30 kg, calculate the relevant solar parameter and write the travel relation appropriate to that trajectory.
Replace Kepler's half-period calculation with rectilinear constant-acceleration motion from rest: set g=mu_sun/a_t^2 and solve Delta r=(1/2)g t^2.
Keep the duration in seconds unchanged, but convert it to days using one day=3600 seconds.
Report the final value in the units used above and include a brief derivation.
